description: Defines the interface for the DisplayMtl class, which implements display functionalities for Metal renderer in ANGLE project.

classes.name: DisplayMtl
classes.description: Implements display functionalities for Metal renderer in ANGLE, managing device, surfaces, contexts, and rendering utilities.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the display with the given egl::Display object.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up the display resources.

methods.name: testDeviceLost
methods.description: Checks if the device has been lost.

methods.name: restoreLostDevice
methods.description: Restores device after a loss.

methods.name: getVendorString
methods.description: Returns the vendor string of the device.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates and returns a new device implementation.

methods.name: waitClient
methods.description: Waits for the client to finish.

methods.name: waitNative
methods.description: Waits for native operations to complete.

methods.name: createWindowSurface
methods.description: Creates a window surface.

methods.name: createPbufferSurface
methods.description: Creates a pixel buffer surface.

methods.name: createPbufferFromClientBuffer
methods.description: Creates a pixel buffer from a client buffer.

methods.name: createPixmapSurface
methods.description: Creates a pixmap surface.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates an image object.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates a rendering context.

methods.name: createStreamProducerD3DTexture
methods.description: Creates a stream producer for D3D textures.

methods.name: getMaxSupportedESVersion
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported ES version.

methods.name: getMaxConformantESVersion
methods.description: Returns the maximum conformant ES version.

methods.name: createSync
methods.description: Creates a synchronization object.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes a surface and context current.

methods.name: populateFeatureList
methods.description: Populates the feature list.

methods.name: isValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Checks if a native window is valid.

methods.name: generateConfigs
methods.description: Generates configuration set.

methods.name: getRendererDescription
methods.description: Returns a description of the renderer.

methods.name: getNativeCaps
methods.description: Returns native capabilities.

methods.name: getNativeTextureCaps
methods.description: Returns native texture capabilities.

methods.name: getNativeExtensions
methods.description: Returns native extensions.

methods.name: getNativeLimitations
methods.description: Returns native limitations.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns feature set.

methods.name: getMetalDevice
methods.description: Returns the Metal device object.

methods.name: cmdQueue
methods.description: Returns the command queue.

methods.name: getFormatTable
methods.description: Returns the format table.

methods.name: getUtils
methods.description: Returns rendering utilities.

methods.name: getStateCache
methods.description: Returns the state cache.

methods.name: getDepthStencilState
methods.description: Returns depth stencil state object based on description.

methods.name: getSamplerState
methods.description: Returns sampler state object based on description.

methods.name: getNullTexture
methods.description: Returns a null texture reference for a given texture type.

methods.name: getPixelFormat
methods.description: Returns pixel format for a given ANGLE format ID.

methods.name: getVertexFormat
methods.description: Returns vertex format for a given ANGLE format ID, considering packing.
